Booz Allen Acquires Ultra I&C Mission Solutions Business

Booz Allen has completed its acquisition of the Ultra I&C Mission Solutions business, now operating as the commercial product and solutions component of Booz Allen’s defense technology business. Together, our complementary capabilities in battle management, secure communications, encryption, and edge compute will accelerate delivery of interoperable, mission-ready technologies for national security.

Our products and packages solutions blend advanced technology with experience in operations across the harshest environments.

Booz Allen offers a range of software platforms, analytical tools, and cybersecurity accelerators that seamlessly integrate today’s most advanced technology with bold thinking and unparalleled expertise. We specialize in designing intelligent, tailor-made solutions built to tackle the nation’s most critical missions.

Whether you’re looking to safeguard your AI systems against cyberattacks or harness and share real-time intelligence at the tactical edge, we have the tools, technology accelerators, and solutions to help you meet today’s challenges head-on. raw_blocks: Driven by purpose. Powered by people. Built to solve the nation’s toughest challenges.
Booz Allen is a private sector leader building advanced technology to fast-track results for government—boosting efficiencies, saving money, and safeguarding America.

Booz Allen has the right people and the right technology to help our clients get ahead in today’s competitive world and prepare for what’s next. We work with the best of the best—Silicon Valley partners, venture capitalists, innovative startups, and small businesses—to deliver tech superiority that outpaces and outperforms any challenge. Our future-focused tech makes America safer, faster, and greater.
Our strength comes from a shared commitment to a singular purpose: Empower People to Change the World.® We believe that tomorrow can be better than today. And we have a role in making it so.

Booz Allen is a technology leader trusted to accelerate change at the heart of our clients’ missions. See how we help solve some of the nation’s largest civil, defense, and national security challenges.
How we lead with purpose and values every day.
Accelerating Outcomes for the Nation
We're delivering tech solutions to make the U.S. stronger, safer, and faster.
Our business is our people. Our engineers, scientists, software developers, technologists, and mission experts live to solve problems that matter.
Join Us. The World Can't Wait.
